  "tactics": [
    "Reset the brief: target 2–3 segments (water-worried homeowners, energy-conscious home monitors, Matter/hobbyist upgraders) instead of every demographic, and run a 2-week test before expanding.",
    "Promote only well-stocked SKUs, two per chosen segment: Leak Sensor 2 (Slate, $43.99, 379 units) and Door Sensor 3 (Black, $27.99, 1,067 units) for water. Do not promote Temp Sensor Gen 4 (0 stock), Door Sensor Gen 4 (discontinued) or Motion Sensor Plus (9 units).",
    "Publish a compatibility and setup page with a clear Matter/Thread/Zigbee table. Confirm generation specs before writing any copy.",
    "Lead messaging with local control, privacy and easy setup. Address cost and setup as the top barriers.",
    "Seed helpful forum answers in Home Assistant, SmartThings and Aqara communities with clear Lumen affiliation disclosure.",
    "Avoid unverified detection or battery-life claims and smoke-sensor safety claims until Lumen test data, certification and legal review exist. Track sign-ups and inquiries for two weeks, then decide whether to expand."
  ],
  "channels": [
    "Owned website: compatibility and setup pages and short install demos",
    "Email to existing Lumen owners",
    "Firmware release notes",
    "Organic social: 30-second leak and door sensor install videos",
    "Home Assistant community forums",
    "SmartThings and Aqara community forums"
  ],
  "KPIs": [
    "Email sign-ups from the compatibility and setup pages over 2 weeks",
    "Inbound inquiries from forums, email and social",
    "Compatibility page views and engagement",
    "Install video views and completion rate",
    "Email open and click-through rates among existing owners",
    "Sensor sales for the four promoted SKUs, with stock levels monitored"
  ]
